tools.name: list_stations
tools.description: Lists Static's stations in dial order: id, name, a one-line description, how many people are listening right now (when known) and a link that tunes in live. Start here to find a station's name or id.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: What's playing right now on one station, or on every station if none is given: the show and episode title, how far in it is and how long is left, the episode's web page, the show's support link when there is one, cover art, and the station's listen link (which tunes in live; listeners don't pick an

tools.name: whats_next
tools.description: The next items coming up on one station, in airing order, with start times (UTC and US Central), shows, episode titles and links. tools.name: find_on_now
tools.description: Looks across every station for what's on now and in the next few hours, matching the words of a topic against show names and episode titles (simple word matching). Leave the topic out for a guide to everything on now and coming up soon. Good for 'is anything about birds on?' or 'when's the next PBS

tools.name: show_details
tools.description: Details for one episode, by its episodeId (from the other tools), or for a show, by name: the show and episode titles, the episode's web page, the show's support link when there is one, and which station airs it and when in the next 24 hours, according to today's schedule.
